slides.title: Your practice score is ^^lying^^ to you
The untimed test
slides.body: Untimed, you get to think. Timed, you get about 95 seconds per math question. A 1400 with the clock off can be a 1250 with it on — because pacing isn't a side condition, it *is* the test.

slides.title: The unreviewed miss
slides.body: Finishing a test and checking the score is where most students stop. But the score isn't the data — the misses are. Ten minutes per miss: what was the trap, and why did you take it. Skip that and you'll take the same test forever.

slides.title: The comfort drill
slides.body: Re-drilling skills you've already mastered feels productive and moves nothing, because your score climbs where your weakest skills climb. Practice that never feels uncomfortable isn't practice — it's rehearsal of what you already knew.
slides.tip: Drill what you miss, not what you like
